design_fields.q1_rationale: The study is a literature review and does not analyze student-level microdata or estimate cognitive achievement scores from ILSA plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study does not analyze student-level survey data, as it is a scoping review synthesizing empirical studies rather than conducting its own analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not analyze student-level survey data where schools are the sampling unit, as it is a literature review.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any validation strategies, as it focuses on synthesizing existing literature rather than conducting empirical analysis.
